title: Judicial screens and hearing/expert selectors silently omit records after first100
environment: Exact archived frontend and Spring Boot with disposable PostgreSQL 18.6 and Chromium; no bulk writes on UAT.
preconditions: 102 active FIRST_INSTANCE courts; 101 valid first-instance proceedings in an owned case
Exact candidate SHA; all records are QA fixtures
steps: Seed synthetic courts and proceedings using qa/independent/final_acceptance_edges.py in a disposable local database only.
Open owned case -> Record proceeding -> inspect Court select: 100 choices, no QA-EDGE-101, no additional page/search control.
Reload case: ladder shows 100 of 101; open Schedule hearing or Refer to an expert: proceeding select contains 100 of 101.
Repeat in Arabic and English; compare DOM options against API response and retain screenshots.
expected: Every allowed record remains reachable through bounded paging or searchable selection. Never silently truncate.
actual: 8 FAIL: 2 court selectors, 2 judicial ladders, 2 hearing selectors and 2 expert selectors (Arabic/English). API pages are correct; the 101st record is missing from every tested UI. No database loss or corruption claimed.
cause: proceedingsApi.ts sets size=100. listCourtsFor/listProceedings discard page metadata and return only first-page items. CaseProceedings, CaseHearings and CaseExperts consume these lists.
scope_limit: Judgment/special-decision helpers share the source pattern, but their separate >100-record UI datasets were not executed in this probe and remain NOT_RUN. UAT SHA attested; defect reproduced locally with identical frontend source.
retest: 102 active courts with second-page court selectable
101 proceedings reachable in ladder and selectable for hearings/expert referrals
Arabic/English; unchanged strict size cap 100 and authorization regression
